app.name: Camper tanks
app.summary: Fresh, grey and black water, gas and diesel of your camper as tanks and bottles with their level.
app.tanks_hint: Which tanks the tile shows, in this order: one per cell, up to four. Empty: tank 1, 2, 3 and 4.
app.amount_hint: Litres or kilograms under the percentage, when the tank has a content sensor.
app.low_hint: Fresh water, gas and diesel turn red at this level or under.
app.high_hint: Grey and black water turn red at this level or over.
app.input_tank_hint: A sensor of the level in %, such as the fresh water or the gas bottle.
app.input_amount_hint: Optional: a sensor of what is in it, in litres (water, diesel) or kilograms (gas).
app.setting_type_hint: Fresh, grey or black water, gas or diesel: how the tank is drawn and when it warns.
app.setting_name_hint: Empty: the sensor's name in Home Assistant.
